column1: # board-parser-corpus/rows.tsv — committed corpus for the bc_cell<->cell() behavioural drift
# gate (BOARD-PIPE-ESCAPE T6). Each non-comment, non-blank line is one BOARD ROW under test,
# The <row> field is the LITERAL board-row text (starts with `|`), byte-identical on every
# platform — no runtime generation, no interpolation. Classes per design §6.5:
#   C1  a lone escaped pipe `\|` inside a cell (odd run -> not a delimiter)
#   C2  an escaped backslash then a real delimiter `\\|` (even run -> IS a delimiter)
#   C3  `\\\|` (odd run of 3 -> not a delimiter, the final `\` escapes the `|`)
#   C4  a cell whose content ends in a bare trailing `\` (last cell, nothing after it)
#   C7  `\|` in the Item cell AHEAD of a backtick row id
